content: Ba Doona Naago
Ta ishatoo! Inttefe daroti astamaareta gidoppetto; gaasoykka nu astamaare gididayti aadheththa pirda ekkanayssa intte ereeta.
Nu wurikka daro miishshan dhuphettoos. Haasayan dhuphettonttaadey diikko izi ba asateth lo7eththi naaganaas dandayza kumeththa asa.
Nuni parata azazanaas bixala barsidi nu koyida mala istta azazoos.
Woykko ane markabeta xeellite; istti ay gitatanne carkon sugetti bizayta gidikkoka markabe laaggizaadey qeeri laafa laaggiza miishshara ba koyzaso efees.
Hessaththoka asateththa garsan inxarsi guuth gida uttada gita wolqqama otoro otorettawus; qeeri tamay gita wora wostti xuuggi dhayssizaakko ane yuushshi qopite.
Inxarsika ba baggara tama mala; qasse nu asateththaa giddon diza iita alame. Asateththaa wursa tunisawussinne asateththaa bolla tama gujjawus; baaska gaanname taman xuugettana.
Mehe, do7a, kafota, biitta bolla gooshettizaytanne abba giddon diza medheteththata ubbaa asi haarana dandayees; isttika haarettida.
Gido attiin inxars haaranaas dandaydaadey oonikka deenna; wodhiza marzey izin kumidaaronne iza shempa ekkontta iita miishsha.
Nuni nu inxarsayra Godaanne Aawaa anjjoos; izinkka Xoossa leemison medhettida asa nayta zaaridi qanggoos.
Anjjoynne qanggeththi issi doonara kezees. Ta ishatoo! Hessi hessaththo hananaas bessenna.
Issi pultto ollafe mal7o haaththinne camo haaththi pultti erizee?
Ta ishatoo! Balase geetettiza miththi wogara ayfe woykko woyne miththi balase miththa ayfe ayfanaas dandayzee? Hessaththoka cammiza haaththafe mal7iza haaththi beettana dandayenna.
Nam7u Qommo Erateth
Intte garsafe akeekara diza era asi oonee? Eray dizaa gidikko ane ba ooso ashketeththaninne aadho erateththara ba lo7o duussan besso.
Qasse camonne qanaatey, inttena xalla dosiza hanoy intte wozinan dizaa gidikko otoreteththi inttes siyettofo; tumaakka kaddofte.
Hinni mala erateththaya saloppe gidikku; hinna qasse biittafe, ashoppenne Xala7eppeko!
Qanaateynne barkka bana siiqoy dizason waasoynne iita oosoy wuri dees.
Saloppe gidida erateththaya gidikko koyro geeshsha; guyeppeka saroteth dosizaaro, dandayzaaro, ero gizaaro, maaroteththinne lo7o ayfey kumidaaro; qasse wordo maaddonttaaronne ulon geney bayndaaro.
Saroteth dosiza asati saroteth zeridi xilloteththa ayfe maxeettes.
